## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/file-upload`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`FileUploadComponent`](/api/file-upload/FileUploadComponent) | Component | Picks files from a drop zone or the browser's file dialog, checks their type, size and count, and lists them. |
| [`formatFileSize`](/api/file-upload/formatFileSize) | Function | A file size in the locale, in the largest unit that keeps it at 1 or more: "512 bytes", "1.5 kB", "20 MB". |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`FILE_UPLOAD_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/file-upload/FILE_UPLOAD_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`FileUploadContext`](/api/file-upload/FileUploadContext) | Interface | What the upload function gets with each file. |
| [`FileUploadItem`](/api/file-upload/FileUploadItem) | Interface | A file in the upload's list, and where it stands. |
| [`FileUploadHandler`](/api/file-upload/FileUploadHandler) | Type alias | Uploads one file, and returns a promise or an observable. |
| [`FileUploadRejection`](/api/file-upload/FileUploadRejection) | Type alias | Why a file wasn't added: its type isn't in `accept` (`type`), it's larger than `maxFileSize` (`maxFileSize`) or smaller than `minFileSize` (`minFileSize`), or the list already holds as many files as it can (`maxFiles`). |
| [`FileUploadStatus`](/api/file-upload/FileUploadStatus) | Type alias | Where a file in the list stands. |
